text:
max: PR #5421 blocked by DAST scan — flag says possible SSRF to internal metadata endpoint. Is this a test-only thing or real? link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/5421
rebecca: :eyes: can you paste the DAST snippet and which env the test hit?
sec-bot: DAST report attached
sec-bot: ```
- issue: External service contact
  path: /pkg/collectors/agent_test.go:42
  evidence: "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/"
  severity: high
```
chen: That file is under test/fixtures — likely a unit test using recorded cassette. But DAST is run against the staging deploy, right?
max: Yeah staging. Tests spin up a small fixture server that points to that URL — we missed sandboxing.
ops-oncall: FYI we rotated keystore IAM role last night (keystore-deploy-role). Audit link: https://console.aws/keystore/audit?run=2024-11-04
sam: I pulled the CloudTrail snippet:
sam: ```
2024-11-04T03:12:05Z CreateGrant keystore-1234 principal=svc/delivery role=keystore-deploy-role
2024-11-04T03:12:18Z UseKey keystore-1234 principal=svc/ci-runner
```
maya (sec): If it's test-only and points at a recorded cassette, we can mark as FP but need evidence: commit hash, test name, and the staging invocation logs that show requests were proxied. Add a suppression with reason "test-fixture-recording" and require a post-merge job to harden the fixture.
alex: Also we should avoid changing RBAC for keystore ad-hoc. Let's record proposed RBAC change in the keystore runbook and add a privileged-approval step for any role grants to keystore.
rebecca: I can take the triage. Plan: 1) verify staging request logs 2) add suppression in SAST/DAST config 3) open security review ticket linking evidence 4) add a follow-up to update fixtures.
max: thanks rebecca. For 1) where do I fetch the staging request logs? nginx or tracing?
rebecca: Use the proxy logs: prod-proxy-staging-logs, and also the test-runner container stdout. Quick grep:
rebecca: ```bash
kubectl logs deploy/test-runner -n staging | grep "169.254.169.254"
# should show the test proxying to the cassette
```
maya (sec): When you open the security review, include these fields: affected-component, PR, test-name, exact DAST evidence blob, keystore-audit-entries (if any), and recommended suppression reason. We'll auto-approve test-fixture FPs once evidence is complete but require an owner to commit the suppression.
ops-oncall: For the RBAC runbook change, suggest this approval flow:
ops-oncall: - request in infra/keystore-approvals board
ops-oncall: - infra leads peer-review
ops-oncall: - security signoff (maya)
ops-oncall: - 24h delay window then grant
alex: Agree. Also add an automated diff for keystore policies in CI preview so reviewers can see exactly what will change.
sam: I'll annotate the CloudTrail with the CI run id so the review ticket can tie to the grant.
max: rebecca, ping me after you push suppression and ticket.
rebecca: will do. Starting now. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: scan status: blocked -> awaiting triage
max: thanks all, keeping this thread for the evidence bundle.
